item.title: Lecture Capture Improvement
item.description:
The Lecture Capture System at CAEN captures high-quality images from the whiteboards in the classrooms. However, image quality can be poor in certain lighting conditions, and images often take up a lot of space and time to process.

Working as an Instructional Technology Developer at CAEN, I developed an algorithm to enhance the appearance of pen strokes against the noisy, unevenly lit background after completing a literature review on whiteboard enhancement, improving the legibility of whiteboards in even the worst lighting conditions. For the issue of unnecessary saving and processing of images, I developed a method to detect unchanged image frames based on differences in Normalized Cross-Correlation, thereby eliminating the need to process those images.
